Update roster (for roster in-charges)

Copy cells from Excel / Google Sheets (including the header row) and paste below. Two layouts work:

A. Long list – columns Date, Department, Duty, Level, Name, Phone, Time (only Date, Department, Duty, Name are required).
B. Your department's usual roster – first column Date (a Day column is fine too), then one column per duty, e.g. Date | Day | Ward Duty | Emergency | 1st on call. Two names in a cell can be separated by / or ,. Fill in the department name below.

Otherwise, the pasted department's entries for the pasted dates replace the old ones; everything else is kept.

"Preview" changes only this phone/computer. To publish for everyone, tap Download page and upload that file in place of the current one.
